instruction: A chubby gable-top milk carton with a big smiling face, rosy blush cheeks, and tiny stubby arms raised cheerfully. Its glossy pastel-blue and white surface features a simple printed cow and rounded cartoon typography. The oversized sparkling eyes and gentle proportions give it an adorable, huggable single-character presence.
